name: List All Listings
description: Returns all units that are not manually excluded, have no active occupancy with a move-out, notice, or move-in date, are currently advertised on the website or external listing platforms, and satisfy the filter criteria.

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter listings by last updated date/time (from). All GET requests must include this filter.

responseFields.name: data
responseFields.description: Array of Listing objects

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the listing

responseFields.name: data[].AcceptingApplications
responseFields.description: Indicates whether or not the listing is accepting applications

responseFields.name: data[].Address1
responseFields.description: The primary street address of the listing

responseFields.name: data[].Address2
responseFields.description: Additional street address information pertaining to the listing

responseFields.name: data[].AdvertisedRent
responseFields.description: The rent per month as advertised

responseFields.name: data[].ApplicationFee
responseFields.description: The application fee amount for the listing

responseFields.name: data[].ApplicationURL
responseFields.description: The URL link(s) to the application page of the listing(s) accepting online applications

responseFields.name: data[].AvailableOn
responseFields.description: The date upon which the listing can be leased

responseFields.name: data[].Bathrooms
responseFields.description: The number of bathrooms listed for the unit

responseFields.name: data[].Bedrooms
responseFields.description: The number of bedrooms listed for the unit

responseFields.name: data[].CatsAllowed
responseFields.description: Indicates whether or not the listing allows cats. A null value indicates that the listing may not have specified a policy for cats.

responseFields.name: data[].City
responseFields.description: The city where the listing is located

responseFields.name: data[].Deposit
responseFields.description: The security, rent, or pet and cleaning deposit amount

responseFields.name: data[].DogPolicy
responseFields.description: Indicates whether or not the listing allows dogs. If dogs are allowed, valid values are: "Large & Small" or "Small Only."

responseFields.name: data[].Email
responseFields.description: The contact email address associated with the listing

responseFields.name: data[].HighAdvertisedRent
responseFields.description: The highest rent per month as advertised

responseFields.name: data[].IsCampaign
responseFields.description: Indicates whether or not the listing is a part of a campaign

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: The date the listing's details were last updated

responseFields.name: data[].ListedRent
responseFields.description: The rent per month as listed on the market. This value reflects either the market rent or the advertised rent, depending on whether "Use Market Rent On Ads" is enabled in the AppFolio Property Manager.

responseFields.name: data[].LowAdvertisedRent
responseFields.description: The lowest rent per month as advertised

responseFields.name: data[].MarketingDescription
responseFields.description: A description of the listing for syndication

responseFields.name: data[].MarketingTitle
responseFields.description: The title of the listing for syndication

responseFields.name: data[].PhoneNumber
responseFields.description: The contact phone number associated with the listing. Includes the extension number if applicable.

responseFields.name: data[].PostedToWebsite
responseFields.description: Indicates whether or not a vacant unit was posted to the AppFolio listings page. If true, the unit is displayed on the AppFolio listings page and accepting applications. If false, the unit is not displayed on the AppFolio listings page.

responseFields.name: data[].PropertyId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the property associated with the listing

responseFields.name: data[].PropertyMarketingDescription
responseFields.description: A description of the property associated with the listing for syndication

responseFields.name: data[].PropertyMarketingTitle
responseFields.description: The title of the property associated with the listing for syndication

responseFields.name: data[].SquareFeet
responseFields.description: The size of the listing in square feet

responseFields.name: data[].State
responseFields.description: The state where the listing is located

responseFields.name: data[].UnitAmenities
responseFields.description: The amenities offered by the building in the listing

responseFields.name: data[].UnitId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the unit associated with the listing

responseFields.name: data[].UnitPhotos
responseFields.description: Photos of the listing

responseFields.name: data[].UnitType
responseFields.description: The floor plan of the listing

responseFields.name: data[].UnitTypeId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the UnitType for the listing

responseFields.name: data[].UtilitiesIncluded
responseFields.description: The utilities which are included with rent

responseFields.name: data[].YouTubeURL
responseFields.description: The URL of the YouTube video for the listing

responseFields.name: data[].Zip
responseFields.description: The zip code where the listing is located

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
